stories.title: Taalfanaat Paulien Cornelisse bleef zich tot het laatste moment verwonderen

en.title: Language enthusiast Paulien Cornelisse continued to marvel until her final moment
en.summary: Paulien Cornelisse, who died Wednesday, was a Dutch performer known for humorously and poignantly examining everyday language and social conventions through her shows, columns, and books.

stories.title: In alles wat Paulien Cornelisse aanraakte knetterde haar volstrekt unieke en originele geest

en.title: In everything Paulien Cornelisse touched crackled her completely unique and original spirit
en.summary: Author, columnist, and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse explored topics ranging from her fascination with language to her personal experience with illness, bringing her distinctive perspective to audiences.

stories.title: Verslagen reacties op overlijden Paulien Cornelisse: 'Ga haar enorm missen'

en.title: Somber reactions to Paulien Cornelisse's death: 'Will miss her greatly'
en.summary: Notable Dutch figures, including Prime Minister Rob Jetten, expressed sadness following the death of writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse at age fifty from cancer.

stories.title: Taalfanaat Paulien Cornelisse bleef altijd onderzoeken, eigenzinnig en met humor

en.title: Language enthusiast Paulien Cornelisse always investigated, was independent-minded, and humorous
en.summary: Writer and performer Paulien Cornelisse, fifty, was known for her creative and distinctive approach to examining language and daily life, sharing her insights through columns, books, and cabaret performances.

stories.title: Rechter schort op laatste moment executie op van eerste vrouw die in 200 jaar in Tennessee doodstraf zou krijgen

en.title: Judge halts execution at last moment of first woman to face death penalty in 200 years in Tennessee
en.summary: A judge stopped the execution of a woman who would have been the first female death penalty case in Tennessee in two centuries.

stories.title: Premier Burnham bevestigt: sterke aanwijzingen dat Iran betrokken was bij de mogelijke aanslag op een militaire basis in Engeland

en.title: Premier Burnham confirms: strong indications that Iran was involved in possible attack on military base in England
en.summary: Five men were arrested near a military base in Fairford last weekend. Premier Burnham indicates strong evidence suggesting Iranian involvement in a potential attack at the location.

stories.title: Schrijver en cabaretier Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden

en.title: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased
en.summary: Dutch writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse died at age 50 from cancer at a hospital in Amsterdam. She was known for her books, theater performances, and documentaries, including her bestselling work from 2009.

stories.title: Schrijfster en cabaretière Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden

en.title: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased
en.summary: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse died at age 50 from cancer at a hospital in Amsterdam on Wednesday.

stories.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden: veelzijdig verzamelaar van observaties over gedrag en taal

en.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased: versatile collector of observations about behavior and language
en.summary: Dutch performer and artist Paulien Cornelisse has died at age 50. She was known for her diverse work collecting and analyzing observations about human behavior and language.

stories.title: Executie van Amerikaanse Christa Pike op het laatste moment opgeschort

en.title: Execution of American Christa Pike halted at the last moment
en.summary: A federal appeals court stopped the execution of Christa Pike in Tennessee about an hour before it was scheduled. Pike was convicted in 1996 for a 1995 murder and had history of childhood trauma and mental health conditions.

stories.title: Veelbesproken executie van Amerikaanse vrouw op laatste moment uitgesteld

en.title: Controversial execution of American woman postponed at last moment
en.summary: A U.S. federal court halted the execution of 50-year-old Christa Pike at the last moment. The judges want to examine whether allegations of childhood sexual abuse were adequately considered during her 1996 trial.

stories.title: Opnieuw boete geëist tegen oud-burgemeester Schuiling om masturberen achter stuur

en.title: Fine again demanded against former mayor Schuiling for masturbating behind wheel
en.summary: Prosecutors seek a 250 euro fine in appeal against former Groningen mayor Koen Schuiling for indecent conduct. They claim evidence proves he masturbated while driving on the highway in March 2024, which Schuiling has denied.
